personalInfo.title: Full-stack wordpress developer
bio: I'm Sohail, a Full Stack WordPress Developer with hands-on expertise in Bricks Builder, Elementor Pro, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), JetEngine, PHP, and Laravel. I've helped businesses across e-commerce, real estate, directories, portfolios, and service industries build websites that don't just look great — they work hard for their business.
